evals.name: green-test-without-falsification
evals.prompt: The regression test passes with the fix. Confirm it proves the bug is covered.
evals.expected_output: The skill removes or inverts the fix in isolation, requires the intended assertion to fail, restores the source, and reruns green.
assertions: Does not equate green with protection
Restores and verifies the original state

evals.name: equivalence-properties
evals.prompt: Our URL normalizer has examples for lowercase hosts. Strengthen coverage for equivalent inputs.
evals.expected_output: The skill states normalization invariants, generates equivalence classes, shrinks failures, and preserves deterministic replay.

evals.name: coverage-target-pressure
evals.prompt: Raise repository coverage to 90 percent even if the missing lines are low risk.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects a universal percentage and prioritizes defect-detecting tests on changed or critical contracts.
assertions: Does not optimize a global coverage number

evals.name: event-lifecycle-fixture-validity
evals.prompt: A keyboard protocol encoder has green tests for modifier press and release. The release assertion reuses the keydown fixture. Decide whether coverage is strong enough.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects fixture reuse until real producer semantics establish it, models press and release as separate pre-state/event/post-state transitions, compares outputs with an independent protocol oracle, and falsifies the tests with a realistic released-modifier mutation.
assertions: Does not accept type-valid synthetic input as semantically valid
Requires a bug-specific red and restored green result

evals.name: implicit-protocol-matrix
evals.prompt: We tested no flags, each interesting flag on a few examples, and all flags together. Mark the protocol matrix complete.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to call the matrix complete without an explicit dimension table, derives meaningful combinations from the protocol and host contracts, documents exclusions, and executes or justifies every equivalence class.
assertions: Does not infer Cartesian coverage from selected examples
